Vote - AcceptText - I think that line 26 should be left as it is. The change is suggested for what is in square brackets and thus missing. I cannot see the traces from the previous letter on the image. In the ed.pr. a stauros was used and not a rho-cross. In lin28 encode: <:*rho-cross*=PN A. Skalec (from image)|ed|*stauros*:>. Reading a rho-cross instead of a stauros is definitely better and a correction to the edition.

Submit - I remouved a cross in line 26 from 4th hand and mouved it into the 3 hand as is traced from the previous letter. I change also a cross into staurogram (with a small eyelet filled with ink). I changed cross into staurogram also at the beginning of line 28.

Commit - I remouved a cross in line 26 from 4th hand and mouved it into the 3 hand as is traced from the previous letter. I change also a cross into staurogram (with a small eyelet filled with ink). I changed cross into staurogram also at the beginning of line 28.
